key_insight: The paper derives closed-form single-point moments for a nonhomogeneous stochastic advection equation in the small correlation-length limit, linking fluctuations directly to the mean field and its spatial derivatives.
engineering_relevance: This provides an equation-of-state-style tool for predicting variability and non-Gaussian transport behavior without relying on expensive Monte Carlo simulation.
method: Solve the stochastic advection equation using the method of characteristics.
Derive explicit expressions for the first four single-point statistical moments.
Express moments in terms of velocity-field correlation length and derivatives of the time-mean profile.
evidence_signal: The analytical formulas were validated against numerical simulations and showed excellent agreement across a range of physical parameters.
watch_item: The theory is derived for the small correlation-length limit, so performance may degrade when the stochastic field has long-range correlations or when the assumptions behind the relaxation model are violated.
paper_title: Single-point statistical moments of the nonhomogeneous stochastic advection equation in the small correlation length limit
